text:
Aisha P: FYI — Miguel C (new hire) is remote in CA, start date Tue Apr 6. We have an I-9 exception request due to location. Can facilities help with a day-1 badge/laptop pickup plan?

Jamal R: @Aisha P can you drop Miguel's offer ID? I need it to file the exception. Also we should confirm his background check status.

Aisha P: Offer ID: RW-9876
Background check submitted via Checkr last week; status shows "pre-adjudication". @Onboard Bot any updates?

Onboard Bot: background-check RW-9876 status: pending review — estimated completion 48-72 hrs. KBA flagged for manual verification.

Priya S: If BG clears before Tue we can ship laptop FedEx overnight. If not, Miguel can do a day-1 kiosk at our SF office for in-person ID verification and pick up a loaner laptop. Which site is nearest?

Miguel C: I'm in Berkeley, SF office is closest. I can come in morning. ETA ~9:30am.

Facilities - Badge Team: We can schedule a 9:15 badge/ID slot. Please confirm headcount (1) and escort host.

Aisha P: Confirmed 1. @Jamal R can you be escort? Also need to add note about I-9 documents: passport or driver's license + SSN. If BG flagged KBA ask Miguel to bring paper ID copies.

Jamal R: I can escort. Re: documents — Miguel please bring one primary ID + SSN card or W-2 + SSN accepted? (short answer: passport preferred)

Miguel C: I'll bring passport + SSN card. Also can I sign e-forms before coming? link?

Priya S: Yes — complete onboarding e-forms here: https://onboarding.internal.redwood/exec?token=RW-9876 (do not share externally) :lock:

Aisha P: For the I-9 remote exception paperwork, HR will need the completed e-form + a photo of the passport. If background not cleared, we'll still allow in-person verification with escort.

Onboard Bot: Action items:
- Miguel: complete e-forms (link above)
- Jamal: confirm escort and badge slot (9:15)
- Facilities: reserve kiosk & prepare loaner laptop (asset tag: LAP-0301)
- HR: file I-9 exception with Offer ID RW-9876

Facilities - Badge Team: Kiosk reserved 9:15-9:30. Loaner LAP-0301 staged at front desk. Escort assigned: Jamal R.

Miguel C: Thanks — I'll finish e-forms tonight and bring passport + SSN card. 

Aisha P: Great. If BG completes before Tue we'll switch to ship-laptop flow; I'll update.

Jamal R: Noted. I posted the calendar invite to Miguel + facilities + Aisha. @Miguel C check your calendar.

Miguel C: Got it, invite accepted. See you Tue :wave:

Aisha P: Closing loop — I'll update thread if BG clears or we switch to shipping. Thanks team :thumbsup:
